gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-glegoo: Glegoo brings big counters and a tall lowercase, its curves left wide open at the mouth, under a heading drawn like a technical pen. Over a long passage, it keeps things easy.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-hanuman: Hanuman is a text serif with a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on the s, under rounded, cord-like heading strokes. And a little extra size would help it hold its own.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-kadwa: Expressive wire-thin lettering with outward-pointing terminals leads, while Kadwa follows in a serif with a larger-than-usual x-height. And that gap between a taut monoline and a sturdy body is what makes the pair work.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-noticia-: Rounded, level, and a bit cheeky: Love Ya Like A Sister holds a steady technical-pen line, with ascenders barely clearing the x-height. But Noticia Text, with lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height, is what gives the pair its dignified literary weight.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-piazzoll: Love Ya Like A Sister draws gentle, monotone strokes with ascenders that barely clear the x-height, while Piazzolla's lowercase nearly matches its capitals. Shrink the heading, though, and that bold personality fades.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-pridi: Love Ya Like A Sister lays down a stroke like toothpaste squeezed in one steady line, while Pridi stands up with proud, near-capital small letters. That gap between squeezed cord and upright serif is the best thing here.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-scope-on: Love Ya Like A Sister is flat and unmodulated in stroke, with outward-pointing terminals and ascenders that barely rise. Scope One counters with a text serif whose big x-height and spilling counters feel openhanded.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-slabo-13: Slabo 13px reads bookish and dignified, with large open counters in its tall a, e and s. Its serif lines sit under a heading that looks like neatly bent pipe cleaner.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-epunda-slab: Commanding up top, Metamorphous has a high-set midline and thick and thin strokes close enough to feel related. Epunda Slab, a text serif with a gaping c and tall rounded forms, is the pair's strongest single quality.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-fauna-one: Generous sidebearings and a high-set midline make Metamorphous unmistakable, sitting between monoline and sharp contrast. Fauna One then supplies a tall middle band, shallow ascenders and descenders, and a wide entry into the e's eye, all working as a classic serif.
